title: Russian Courgette Gratin
description: A flavorful and comforting gratin dish made with courgettes, heavenly and herbed russian cheese. Perfect for a dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: 2. Slice the courgettes into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
3. In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
4. Add the sliced courgettes and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, until tender.
5. In a separate saucepan, melt the heavenly cheese over low heat.
6. Add the russian herbed cheese and stir until well combined.
7. In a greased 8x8-inch baking dish, arrange a layer of cooked courgettes.
8. Pour a layer of the cheese mixture over the courgettes.
9. Repeat steps 7 and 8 until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
10. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
11. Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
